name: Tormented By the Past
objectiveText: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you. Crystal of Zin-Malor (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: the location of the highbourne is 56,44
replies: Leave Everlook, and head straight for the lake. It is slightly south of due west of Everlook. Try to hit the shore in the middle of the lake. On your left there will be a glowing blue thing in the ice. It is in front of a building that has the "Remorseful Highborn" you are looking for. Circle wide to the right of the building and you will need to kill only one Highborn Ghost.

comments.body: The "Remorseful Highborn" is on the East/SE edge of the frozen lake inside an open-walled building.

The coords are 56,44. They are the Ruins of Kel'Theril shown on your map. The Remorseful Highborne wanders inside.

Edited, Mon Dec 12 22:24:30 2005
You get it after completing the two Fragments of the Past quests (level 56 and 57)
The Remorseful Highborne is at 56, 44. That's in one of the buildings on the southeast side of the lake.
Prior step is https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=5247

When you talk to highborne spirit behind the building, you see yellow ? above her head.
After talking you can leave the place safe for some time. Alle spirits around you are suddenly green for 20 seconds or so, so you can walk easy and safe away without aggro risk :)

Equip is not needed. Just talk.
